rules.statement: A mortgage executed by a party to a pending partition action of an interest that will be allotted to him in the final decree is not considered an 'encumbrance' under Section 48 of the Partition Act, and the mortgagee can sue on the mortgage bond after the final decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "An interest which vests only upon entry of the final decree is not contemplated in the term 'encumbrance' in section 48 of the Partition Act. Accordingly, where, after interlocutory decree has been entered in a pending partition action and before the final decree, a party mortgages the interest that will be allotted to him under the final decree, the mortgagee will be entitled to sue on the mortgage bond after the final decree is entered, even if the interest mortgaged is not conserved in the final decree."
